name: task-create
description: Create a new task in the backlog. Provide a title and optionally description, owner (curia/ceo/external), priority (0-100), source (ceo/agent/scheduler/coordinator), due date, tags, parent task, blocked-by task, waiting-on contact, and an intent anchor. source is the kind of origin, not which agent or job created the task — the calling agent is recorded automatically as source_agent_id. Do not pass an agent name, job id, or agent:... identifier; omit source to let the runtime derive it. When wake_at is set, schedules a one-shot wake-up for this task at that time. Set target_agent_id to assign the task (and its wake-up) to another agent — e.g. the coordinator scheduling a debrief task for the meeting-debrief specialist. Set progress_note to seed the task's first progress note (it becomes the row's last progress note, surfaced in the digest).

inputs.title: string
inputs.source: string? (one of: ceo, agent, scheduler, coordinator — the kind of origin, not which agent. The calling agent is recorded automatically as source_agent_id. Do not pass an agent name, job id, or agent:... identifier. Omit to let the runtime derive it.)
